extension.description: Right-click supported files in Explorer or editor tab to open them in VS Code's built-in Simple Browser. File extensions are user-configurable.
configuration.title: Open in Integrated Browser
configuration.extensions.description: List of file extensions (without leading dot) that show the **Open in Integrated Browser** command in the context menu. Example: `html`, `pdf`, `svg`. Changes take effect immediately.
configuration.autoAssociateExtensions.de: List of file extensions (without leading dot) that should automatically open in Integrated Browser. Files with these extensions will have `workbench.editorAssociations` updated to use this extension's editor as their default, which forwards to VS Code's built-in Simple Browser when available. Example: `html`, `pdf`, `svg`. Changes take effect immediately.
configuration.setHtmlAsDefaultEditor.des: When enabled, `*.html` files default to this extension's Integrated Browser editor. The editor opens in VS Code's built-in Simple Browser when available. This default is applied automatically after installation and can be toggled anytime from Settings.
